author: Bill Ferguson
name: get_lib_manpages
description: Extracts the embedded documentation from darktable's Lua libraries and renders it as troff man pages and PDF files.
description-extensive: This is a developer-oriented helper that pulls the built-in documentation out of darktable's scripting libraries and turns it into standard Unix man pages and PDF documents. It is mainly useful for people who write or study darktable scripts and want readable reference documentation. Generating the PDF versions requires the groff and ps2pdf command-line tools.
